reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: One of the best matt setting sprays I’ve used, you can feel it setting the make up, but my face doesn’t feel tight after use I recommend using a really hydrating primary when using this cause I found if I don’t use a hydrating primer and use this that my face feels a bit dry but when I use a hydrating primer, I don’t have this problem at all the finishes amazing and I would purchase again
reviews.zh: 我用過最好嘅霧面定妝噴霧之一，你可以 feel 到佢幫你定妝，但用完之後塊面唔會覺得緊。我建議用呢支嘅時候配一支超保濕嘅底霜，因為我發現如果唔用保濕底霜直接用呢支，塊面會有少少乾；但用保濕底霜嘅話就完全冇呢個問題，妝效好好，會再回購

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text:
Really great makeup setting spray. My daughter and I use this and we find it very effective. Helps your makeup stay on all day long. 
Would definitely buy this again.
reviews.zh:
非常好用嘅定妝噴霧。我同我個女都用緊，覺得好有效。可以令妝容保持一整天。
一定會再回購。

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: The makeup fixer good for during makeup, it help to settle down the foundation if it too thick or still no dry. But for stay well after makeup it doesn't really do well
reviews.zh: 呢支定妝噴霧用喺化妝途中就好用，粉底太厚或者未乾透嘅時候可以幫手 settle。但化完妝之後想 keep 住個妝就唔太得

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: I’ve been using the TIRTIR makeup fixer and it really helps my makeup stay in place all day without feeling heavy or sticky. It gives a nice, natural finish and keeps my skin looking fresh even through long days.
reviews.zh: 我一路用緊 TIRTIR 嘅定妝噴霧，佢真係幫到我個妝 keep 住成日都唔甩，又唔會覺得厚重或者黐笠。妝效自然靚，就算捱長日子皮膚都 keep 到 fresh。

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: Nie jest trwały raczej nie zakupię ponownie
reviews.zh: 唔算持久，應該唔會再買。

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: So far, I can say that it has helped extend my makeup throughout the night. The mist is fine and doesn't feel like I'm squirting myself. It does blur out my powder nicely as to not leave me cakey. I want to try it all day but for now as a night fixer, it's great.
reviews.zh: 暫時嚟講，我可以話佢幫到我個妝 keep 到成晚。噴霧好幼細，唔會覺得自己係被噴一身。佢可以好好咁柔化我嘅碎粉，唔會令妝容變得厚重。想試吓用成日，但暫時當夜間定妝用，已經好正。

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: A very good fixing spray- I do enjoy using it as a base applying it after sunscreen to adhere the makeup more seamlessly onto the face. It does sweat off a bit after a sweaty dance class. The scent is not too strong and does not have a film like feeling on the face after the spray. Would recommend if you’re looking for a fixing spray to use before makeup.
reviews.zh: 一支好好嘅定妝噴霧——我鍾意喺搽防曬之後用佢做底，令妝容更加貼服。不過跳完一課 dance 之後都會有少少甩汗。味道唔算太濃，噴完之後塊面都唔會有薄膜嘅感覺。如果你想搵一支妝前用嘅定妝噴霧，我會推薦呢支。

reviews.shade: TIRTIR Mask Fit Make up Fixer 80ml
reviews.text: So far the product is really great! The scent is nice and definitely not as strong as I thought it may be. I can't really give it a five star as I haven't used it for too long. My make up is definitely lasting longer throughout the day!
reviews.zh: 暫時用落覺得產品好好用！味道唔錯，肯定冇我預期中咁濃。用嘅時間唔算太耐，所以真係唔敢畀五分。妝容真係比之前持久咗一整日！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
